hypotheses.evidence: 401/500 accounts disagree across at least one of four account-level indicators; account flag vs any event differs for 312 accounts.
hypotheses.counterevidence: The four indicators do not have identical intended semantics, so disagreement is not automatically a source-system error.
hypotheses.next_test: Define eligible paid account/subscription state, cancellation, reactivation and effective timestamps; reconcile sampled records against source contracts.

hypotheses.evidence: Segment prevalences vary by label; see segment table with denominators, Wilson intervals and sample-size warnings.
hypotheses.counterevidence: Rankings change with label; acquisition cost, margin, value and temporal outcome are unavailable; composition can confound comparisons.
hypotheses.next_test: Recompute by acquisition cohort after valid outcome and exposure are instrumented; compare channel economics and retention.

hypotheses.evidence: 5568 usage rows remain inside linked subscription intervals; first observed interval-valid usage is only a proxy.
hypotheses.counterevidence: 19432 usage rows are excluded from the interval sensitivity and signup/onboarding timestamps are not a canonical activation event.
hypotheses.next_test: Instrument onboarding completion and first-value event tied to account/subscription, then monitor 7/30-day activation.

hypotheses.evidence: Among interval-valid usage, the top decile of accounts represents 25.1% of recorded usage counts.
hypotheses.counterevidence: Usage count is not value realized; interval-valid use is still not a verified pre-cancellation window.
hypotheses.next_test: Define meaningful adoption by feature/use case and compare prospectively within eligible cohorts.

hypotheses.evidence: Ticket outcomes are available by each alternative account label; account-cluster satisfaction and escalation summaries are included alongside ticket-row values.
hypotheses.counterevidence: Ticket volume is selected by support need; satisfaction is missing for 825/2,000 tickets and not time-aligned to cancellation.
hypotheses.next_test: Link ticket histories to reconciled cancellation dates; review escalations and conduct customer follow-up.

hypotheses.evidence: Reason codes and subscription-row monetary fields can be described; price/budget codes occur in event records.
hypotheses.counterevidence: Reason codes are not causal proof; contract row semantics, realized value and customer willingness-to-pay are unavailable.
hypotheses.next_test: Validate reason codes in customer interviews and reconcile invoice/contract snapshots before price intervention.

hypotheses.evidence: Usage error counts and event reason codes are available as exploratory signals.
hypotheses.counterevidence: No product incident exposure, feature entitlement, release history or account-linked verified cancellation timeline.
hypotheses.next_test: Join telemetry to release/incident exposure and verify with a sampled customer review.

recommendations.action: Reconcile the lifecycle and build a monthly eligible-account snapshot
recommendations.target: All accounts and subscription rows with conflicting state
recommendations.evidence: 401/500 accounts differ across outcome indicators; 600 event rows lack reliable subscription linkage.
recommendations.effort: Medium; planning estimate only, not a measured cost
recommendations.success_metric: Audited state coverage and stable eligible denominator by month
recommendations.validation: Sample source contract/invoice records and compare against canonical account-subscription state
recommendations.impact: Enables a valid churn rate and prevents misallocated intervention; financial impact not quantified.

recommendations.action: Instrument activation and meaningful adoption on a shared timeline
recommendations.target: New accounts by acquisition channel, plan and trial status
recommendations.evidence: Usage timestamps materially fall outside linked subscription intervals; current first use is only a proxy.
recommendations.effort: Medium; event taxonomy and instrumentation work
recommendations.success_metric: Coverage of signup, onboarding completion, first-value event and 7/30-day adoption
recommendations.validation: Audit event ordering and cohort completeness before comparing activation rates
recommendations.impact: Improves diagnosis and targeting; no churn reduction is claimed.

recommendations.action: Run a small randomized adoption/support pilot after eligibility is reconciled
recommendations.target: Eligible accounts with verified active state and agreed low-adoption or unresolved-support criteria
recommendations.evidence: Usage and ticket signals are available but not causal or temporally valid today.
recommendations.effort: Low-to-medium pilot; cost per account must be estimated locally before launch
recommendations.success_metric: 90-day verified account retention; guardrails: satisfaction, escalations and service cost
recommendations.validation: Account-level random assignment, stratified by plan/channel, intention-to-treat analysis
recommendations.impact: Unknown until experiment; scenario tool is hypothetical only.

limitations: Synthetic public challenge data; observed associations do not establish business causality.
No eligible customer-month denominator or reconciled lifecycle history; logo/subscription/revenue churn rates and retention cohorts are not identifiable.
No account is assigned a calibrated future churn probability.
The account queue is for lifecycle/data review and is not a risk score.
Revenue row values and refund totals are not current recurring revenue or preventable loss.
